experiments.claim: Theorem (continuity of termination): Chi is preserved in all three cases; the record chain and the termination condition separate them.
Proposition (Chi alone is not an identity criterion): independently authored structures of identical specification share Chi yet are distinct individuals.
Corollary (snapshot and restore): a restored structure has the same Chi and is a distinct individual, because the chain passes through an open (serialised) stage.
Theorem (no consistent self-verification): for every total verifier V, the diagonal value V(D_V) is self-refuting -- each of the two possible values entails the other.
Theorem (consumer-relativity): the same item registers different cells in consumers with different graphs, and each registration is correct at its own floor; none is privileged.
